title: Psychedelic Kitchen Ghost
description: A surreal double-exposure scene of a vintage kitchen overlaid with translucent, colorful psychedelic patterns and swirls. A woman in retro attire stands behind a counter with a bright red appliance while a small ghostly figure appears near the sink area.
prompt: A surreal double exposure of a 1950s style kitchen interior, translucent layers of vibrant psychedelic swirls and circular patterns in purple, magenta and cyan overlaying the scene. A woman in vintage dress and updo stands at the counter with a bright red appliance, a small ghostly child-like figure near the sink, old television and blue pottery in foreground, dreamy and haunting atmosphere, painterly style
